purpose: Original narrative/cinematic background art, inspired by the requested mood; all typography is rendered from actual fonts separately

prompts.cloudwind: Create an ORIGINAL art background, wide 2.05:1 landscape, for the upper image section of a typeface poster. NO text, NO lettering, NO calligraphy, NO typography, NO logos, NO border. This must feel like a frame from a story or an art-house film, not a stock photo or a studio-product arrangement. Large meaningful space, emotional color, deliberate light and composition, fine organic grain. The scene continues across the image; leave readable space for large type through quiet sky or tonal areas, not a blank rectangular text zone. Medium: expressive oil painting on textured linen, visible lyrical brush strokes. A vast wind-swept green highland under luminous storm-blue clouds; a narrow pale path curls down toward the far-right distance, where a VERY SMALL traveler carries a warm yellow umbrella. The traveler is a tiny scale cue, not a portrait. Sea-green grass leans in the wind, a fragile opening of pale golden light on the horizon. Deep blue-green and moss with one tiny amber accent. Poetic solitude, motion, hope, cinematic long shot, rich paint texture. Keep the upper-left/middle area darker and spacious for an ivory brush-font title. Original landscape, not a recreation of an existing poster.
